title: Senior CCTV Engineer
description:
At Astrea Recruitment, we’ve been turning job searches into exciting new beginnings for 19

years! With offices in Bulgaria and Serbia, we connect top talent with leading Bulgarian and

international companies. We believe in helping people grow into their best selves, and our

ever-growing network of happy candidates and clients is what drives us forward. Let’s shape

the future together!


For one of our clients – a leading software development company and award-winning game

provider in the casino industry, creating immersive and innovative gaming experiences as part

of an international tech group, we are on a lookout for confident and energetic people for the

role – Senior CCTV Engineer.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

*Oversee the operation and upkeep of core network components — including firewalls,

switches, and routers — to ensure stable and secure connectivity;

*Design, configure, and maintain High Availability VPNs to ensure continuous, encrypted

communication between multiple sites;

*Work in close coordination with the CCTV systems team to improve network efficiency,

dependability, and system uptime;

*Carry out routine network surveillance and health checks using advanced tools to identify

and resolve issues before they impact service;

*Apply firmware and software updates to network devices on a regular basis to eliminate

security flaws and meet industry standards;

*Develop thorough technical documentation, such as network topology maps and

configuration records, to support troubleshooting and operations.


Requirements:

*A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in network engineering roles;

*Cisco credentials (e.g., CCNA, CCNP) or comparable certifications/training;

*Proficient in TCP/IP, switching technologies (VLANs, Spanning Tree), and routing protocols

(EIGRP, OSPF, BGP);

*Solid understanding of VPN, QoS, and High Availability technologies (VRRP, HSRP, VSS,

vPC, Multichassis EtherChannel);

*Knowledge of network security concepts including IPSec, UTM, DDoS protection, and

Syslog protocol;

*Skilled in packet analysis using tools like Wireshark; Familiar with SNMP, DNS, DHCP,

HTTP, SMTP;

*Comfortable working in Linux environments;

*Experience with virtualization platforms such as ESXi and Proxmox.


Our client offers:

*Competitive salary and additional bonuses;

*Stable and secure job and paid annual leave days;

*Private health insurance;

*Paid training and ongoing learning opportunities for all employees;

*Opportunities for career growth and development;

*Work in a friendly environment that values skills and collaboration.


If you feel excited and confident that you’re the perfect fit, we encourage you to take the next

step. Kindly share your detailed resume in English when you get a chance. (and don’t forget

to include the reference number LL_).


Rest assured that we will reach out promptly to the candidates whose profiles closely match

our requirements. Your privacy is of utmost importance to us, and all your information is

safeguarded in compliance with the regulations of the Commission for the Protection of

Personal Data (Astrea Recruitment, reg. No 1809).

title: Front End & Mobile Developer (São Paulo)
description:
Enabley is hiring: Front End & Mobile Developer (São Paulo)

  • Enabley is a fast-growing learning technology startup headquartered in Israel with a substantial and growing customer base in Brazil.
  • We’re looking for a skilled Front End & Mobile Developer  to join our international product development group, working full-time with our local team in São Paulo!
  • Our platform serves companies with deskless workforces in industries like retail, transportation, manufacturing, healthcare etc. (e.g., Vivo, Coca-Cola, Chilli Beans, Unilever and many others). We help employees learn and grow on the go, whether through desktop or mobile, ensuring they stay connected to their company, no matter where they are.


What You’ll Do

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of our white-label mobile apps using Flutter , ensuring high-quality experiences across both Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store) platforms.
  • Manage app store deployments, updates, and compliance for multiple branded mobile apps.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across global teams to roll out new features quickly and improve existing ones.
  • Develop and maintain responsive web applications with a strong focus on front-end performance and scalability.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and follow best practices for software development.
  • Use modern AI-assisted development to accelerate productivity and code quality. 
  • Work with tight schedules and changing priorities, actively seeking solutions.


What We Offer

  • A dynamic and supportive work environment with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and getting the job done with a smile :)
  • The chance to impact learning experiences for millions of deskless workers, across industries and continents.
  • Daily exposure to modern AI development practices and a product stack that actively incorporates AI into customer-facing features.
  • A hybrid work model – at least 2 days a week in our São Paulo offices (Berrini/Pinheiros area; this is a must), with the rest remote.

Who You Are

  • Experienced Front End & Mobile Developer: 5+ years building software products in real-world, production environments.
  • Mobile Development Expertise: Hands-on experience with Flutter, including publishing and maintaining white-label apps on Google Play and the Apple App Store.
  • Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in React, Redux, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front-end architecture patterns.
  • AI Mindset: Familiar with using AI tools to enhance development workflows. Enthusiastic about helping build AI-powered product features and curious about how AI is transforming software user interactions.
  • Fluent in English: Strong communication skills in English are essential, as it is our primary working language.
  • Self-Starter: You’re motivated, resourceful, and capable of taking initiative—even when specifications are still being gathered.
  • Team Player: Collaborative, curious, thrives in fast-paced environments, and fun to work with :)


Ready to code the future of learning?

  • Apply now and join us in shaping the future of learning for deskless workers!

title: Software Developer
description:
MatchPoint is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry specific best practices and expertise.

We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Title: Software Developer

Location: Onsite - Sao Paulo - Brazil

Salary: 11,000/BRL per month.


1. Summary

Our Client is seeking a skilled and motivated Software Developer to join our growing team in Brazil. This role will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of software modules for automotive applications, primarily focusing on Infotainment (IVI) and potentially Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS). The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of software engineering principles, a passion for writing high-quality code, and the ability to work collaboratively within an Agile development environment.

2. Responsibilities

· Software Development: Design, develop, and maintain software modules according to specified requirements and design specifications.

· Testing: Write and execute unit and integration tests to ensure the quality and reliability of the software.

· Code Review: Participate in code reviews to provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to coding standards.

· Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize software performance to meet system requirements.

· Debugging & Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve software defects through debugging and troubleshooting.

· Collaboration: Work closely with other developers, testers, and system engineers to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software solutions.

· Documentation: Create and maintain clear and concise technical documentation.

· Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the improvement of software development processes and methodologies.

· Agile Participation: Actively participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and sprint retrospectives.

3. Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

· Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience.

· Experience with automotive software development is highly preferred, with a focus on either Infotainment (IVI) or Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS).

· Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.

· Familiarity with software configuration management tools (e.g., Git).

4. Skills

· Technical Skills:

o Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C++, C, Python).

o Experience with software testing frameworks and methodologies.

o Familiarity with embedded systems development is a plus.

o Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) is a plus.

o Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (e.g., CAN, LIN, Ethernet) is a plus.

· Language Skills:

o Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential.

· Soft Skills:

o Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

o Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

o Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

o Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

o Proactive attitude and willingness to learn new technologies.

title: Auditor interno sênior
description:

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL


BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.


Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.


Why joining us?


Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.


Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.


Why do we want you?


We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.



Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:


1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.


Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:


1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.


Competences:


a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.


Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.


Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.


· What do we offer?


1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.


Let’s move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

Ensino médio completo;

Desejável superior ou técnico em elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, hidráulica;

Curso de NR10.

Capacidade resolutiva;

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
Objetivo da função

Suportar, do ponto de vista operacional e analítico , os processos de importação e exportação assegurando compliance aduaneiro , controle de prazos e custos , e comunicação fluida com fornecedores chineses e parceiros logísticos.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Operação de importação/exportação marítima (FCL/LCL) : solicitações de booking com armadores, gestão de cut-offs , VGM , SI e draft BL .
  • Acompanhamento ponta a ponta : confirmação de embarque, transbordos , ETA/ETD , follow-up com agente de carga e desembaraço com despachante.
  • Documentos : conferência/emissão de commercial invoice , packing list , BL , certificado de origem , DUE , LI/DUIMP (quando aplicável).
  • Classificação fiscal e aplicação de Incoterms 2020
  • Interface com órgãos anuentes quando aplicável ao produto (ex.: ANATEL , INMETRO para itens/tecnologia), em conjunto com o despachante.
  • Controle de custos e prazos : acompanhamento de lead time , free time , demurrage/detention , atualização de planilhas e dashboards (Excel/BI).
  • Lançamento e acurácia de dados em controles internos.
  • Suporte à cotação de frete/seguro , comparação de propostas e apontamento de oportunidades de economia.
  • Comunicação em inglês com fornecedores/agentes na China (fuso e follow-ups estruturados).
  • Preparação de relatórios de status, KPIs e pós-embarque para áreas Compras, Financeiro, Fiscal e Operações .

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Comércio Exterior, Logística, Administração ou Relações Internacionais (recém-formado/a ou até 2 anos).
  • 1 ano de experiência prática em importação/exportação , com exposição a marítimo/contêineres .
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação com fornecedores/agents).
  • Conhecimento de Incoterms 2020 , NCM , Siscomex , documentos de comércio exterior e fluxo de desembaraço .
  • Excel intermediário (tabelas dinâmicas, PROCX/VLOOKUP, controle de prazos/custos).
  • Controles em BI (Power BI ou similar) para montar/atualizar dashboards simples.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com fornecedores chineses (fuso, holiday calendar, negociações FOB/CIF).
  • Noções de DUIMP , Drawback , e programas OEA (mesmo que por exposição).

Competências comportamentais

  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e acurácia documental.
  • Priorizar e cumprir prazos (cut-offs, free time, follow-up).
  • Comunicação clara com diversos stakeholders (interno/externo).
  • Proatividade para antecipar riscos (demurrage/detention, faltas documentais).
  • Vontade de aprender e evoluir tecnicamente .

Jornada & modelo de trabalho

  • Presencial (segunda a sexta, horário comercial).
  • Salário: Compativel com o praticado no mercado
  • Benefícios:
  • VR.
  • VT .

title: Chief Legal Officer
description:
Gold & Aron Conseil is an executive search company. We are recruiting a CLO on behalf of our client.


Our client is a growing Brazilian fintech with strong social impact and evolving from a startup into a disciplined, institutional-grade organization. In order to accelerate growth even more, the firm is seeking a Chief Legal Officer . The Ideal candidate is someone who can lead all legal related initiatives, navigate complex landscapes, build & manage a high performing team, serve as a trusted advisor to the founders and get things done (not as an advisor but as a legal executive-operator).


Responsibilities

  • Manage all legal matters (mostly domestic but some international exposure as well).
  • Build, structure, and lead a high-performing in-house legal team, including: (i) Defining clear scopes between in-house vs. external counsel; (ii) Hiring, developing, and, when necessary, upgrading talent; (iii) Implementing SLAs, prioritization frameworks, and legal intake processes; (iv) Ensuring legal is a force multiplier, not a bottleneck
  • Process Professionalization: Transition the legal department from "startup mode" to a disciplined "financial institution standard".
  • Risk Optimization: Translate legal constraints into business options. Quantify downside, propose alternatives, and recommend paths that maximize long-term enterprise value
  • Regulatory: Manage the process of applying for SCD (Sociedade de Crédito Direto) License, exposure to Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Open Finance, Consumer protection at scale (BACEN + SENACON dynamics), Structuring new financial products under regulatory ambiguity
  • Be ready to contribute to potential capital raise/M&A processes, manage data rooms, oversee due diligence, and negotiate complex term sheets.


Qualifications

  • 15–20 years of experience.
  • Ideal candidate will bring a generalist expertise being able to navigate Brazilian Employment law, Tax basics, Contract law (Brazil & International), Regulatory, M&A.
  • Ideal candidate has a combination of top-tier law firm and in-house
  • Start-up experience (ideally at a Fintech)
  • Proven People Leadership
  • Language: English fluency is a must.
  • Location: São Paulo. (Hybrid work environment)


This role is NOT for:

  • Pure advisory profiles who prefer external counsel to execution
  • Lawyers who have not personally built, hired, and performance-managed teams
  • Professionals uncomfortable making fast risk trade-offs with imperfect information
  • Candidates who need heavy structure before acting

title: Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role:

As a Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist, you will play a vital role in our commitment to implementing best practices in quality control. This position is dedicated to ensuring the highest quality standards in our products through collaboration with suppliers, monitoring quality processes, and enhancing our aftersales services. Your contributions will not only enhance our products and services but also strengthen positive relationships with our customers.Job Description:

  • Collaborate with suppliers to establish clear quality expectations and standards for components and materials.
  • Evaluate suppliers reports to ensure compliance with quality standards and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor the quality processes for incoming materials, documenting and analyzing relevant data and processes.
  • Manage warranty processes with suppliers, including the preparation and submission of technical reports, claims, and supporting documentation.
  • Create detailed re ports on product quality metrics and supplier performance, identifying trends and opportunities for enhancement.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to communicate findings and recommend actions that improve product quality and customer satisfaction.


Hard Skills:

  • Experience in quality assurance, supplier management, or a related field within manufacturing or the automotive industry.
  • Proficiency in quality management systems and reporting tools that facilitate effective data analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess product performance and identify recurring quality issues.
  • Advanced English proficiency for effective drafting and communication.


Soft Skills:

  • Highly Disciplined:  Demonstrates a strong commitment to accuracy, organization, and consistency in all tasks.
  • Process-Oriented Thinking:  Employs systematic thinking to analyze workflows and enhance problem-solving capabilities, ensuring efficiency in processes.
  • Attention to Detail:  Conducts thorough evaluations of supplier quality and product performance, focusing on delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Effective Communication Skills:  Communicates clearly and concisely with stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual understanding across teams.

title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, organized, and hands-on professional with strong leadership skills to coordinate the areas of Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit . This is a strategic position with a structured career path toward a Finance Manager role within up to 18 months , based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury

  • Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and projected cash flow;
  • Manage bank accounts, balances, reconciliations, and financial investments;
  • Plan fund transfers between SPVs (SPEs) and partners;
  • Support Controllership with monthly close and cash flow projections;
  • Ensure banking security, proper segregation of duties, and approval levels.

Accounts Payable

  • Coordinate the full payment cycle (review, approval, and execution);
  • Ensure accurate posting of invoices, tax withholdings, and cost centers;
  • Implement and maintain payment policies;
  • Control due dates for contracts, insurance policies, and recurring expenses;
  • Monitor advances, corporate credit cards, and payment exceptions;
  • Support financial automation initiatives and accounting integration.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Coordinate billing (rent, charges, fees, and services);
  • Monitor delinquency, aging reports, collections, and postings in the ERP;
  • Implement preventive and corrective collection policies;
  • Support negotiations with customers and legal teams when required;
  • Develop management reports by property/project.

Credit

  • Implement and continuously review the company’s credit policy;
  • Perform customer financial and credit analysis;
  • Classify customers according to risk levels;
  • Monitor delinquency indicators and credit performance;
  • Train commercial and operational teams on credit rules and processes.

Management & Strategy

  • Develop financial dashboards and performance indicators;
  • Lead continuous improvement and automation projects;
  • Act as the financial interface with partners, funds, and investors;
  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;
  • Act strategically alongside Controllership and Executive Management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit;
  • Experience working with financial ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;
  • Leadership profile with autonomy and strategic mindset;
  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate sector;
  • Experience managing financial flows between SPVs (SPEs);
  • Proven experience implementing financial automation.

What We Offer

  • Clear and structured career path toward a Finance Manager position;
  • Strong technical and strategic development environment;
  • Direct exposure to business financial decision-making.

  • Experiência em auditoria de TI / Segurança da Informação, preferencialmente em Instituições Financeiras.
  • Experiência com auditoria de redes, análise de vulnerabilidades, resposta a incidentes, testes de intrusão, controle de identidade e acesso.

title: Especialista em Consolidação
description:
Somos uma multinacional líder em infraestrutura de telecomunicações na América Latina, com foco na construção de torres (built-to-suit), DAS (Distributed Antenna System), small cells, assim como vários projetos especiais de infraestrutura neutra.


Estamos à procura de um(a) Especialista em Consolidação , com atuação baseada no Brasil e escopo global, prestando suporte às operações da QMC.


Essa posição tem papel estratégico na consolidação das demonstrações financeiras do grupo, no alinhamento das políticas contábeis às normas internacionais e no suporte à liderança com informações contábeis precisas, consistentes e tempestivas para a tomada de decisão.


Sobre a função


O(a) Especialista em Consolidação será responsável por atualizar e garantir a aplicação uniforme das políticas e procedimentos contábeis conforme normas do IASB, CPC, IFRS e US GAAP, além de supervisionar a consolidação das informações financeiras das empresas do grupo.


Atuará de forma próxima à gerência, apoiando o fluxo de informações contábeis, auditorias, análises gerenciais e iniciativas de melhoria contínua dos processos da área.


Responsabilidades


  • Apoiar a elaboração de informações e relatórios contábeis, garantindo acuracidade, consistência e clareza dos dados consolidados.
  • Elaborar a consolidação das demonstrações financeiras das empresas do grupo, incluindo participação patrimonial, notas explicativas e fluxo de caixa.
  • Salvaguardar e validar os mapeamentos de contas entre relatórios analíticos e sintéticos, avaliando inconsistências de classificação.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de balancetes e fluxos de caixa mensais consolidados, contábeis e gerenciais.
  • Atender e acompanhar auditorias internas e externas, assegurando aderência às normas contábeis, legislação vigente e prazos estabelecidos.
  • Prestar suporte às atividades contábeis e fiscais mais complexas, especialmente relacionadas à tributação e imposto de renda.

  • Apoiar e desenvolver melhorias nos processos, rotinas, controles e organização do trabalho, buscando ganhos de eficiência e produtividade.
  • Propor e desenvolver ferramentas de análise que apoiem a tomada de decisão e ofereçam visão clara dos resultados operacionais atuais e futuros.
  • Apoiar a gerência no fluxo de informações contábeis, garantindo que dados corretos cheguem às áreas relevantes dentro dos prazos adequados.


Requisitos Necessários


  • Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou Economia.

  • Experiência em cargos relacionados à área de consolidação.
  • Desejável experiência de 1 ano em empresas de telecomunicações ou setores similares.

title: Gerente Júnior - Programa Select | São Paulo Capital e Interior
description:
OPORTUNIDADE NAS ÁREAS : COMERCIAL, LOGÍSTICA E FINANCEIRO.

Trabalho 100% presencial


CONHEÇA A AMBEV


ENTRE PARA UM TIME QUE SONHA TÃO GRANDE COMO VOCÊ!


Somos milhares de apaixonados e apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. Temos um orgulho imenso do nosso poder de impacto positivo e reconhecemos que, agindo como donos e donas, cada um de nós desempenha um papel fundamental no sucesso do nosso ecossistema. Somado a isso, todas nossas grandes conquistas tem o sabor da colaboração! A Nossa Cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde as pessoas possam ser o melhor delas mesmas - e nos ajudar a ser a nossa melhor versão! Procuramos gente com paixão, curiosidade e coragem para fazer a diferença aqui.


Acolhemos talentos diversos, porque acreditamos que grandes ideias vêm de pessoas com diferentes trajetórias. Oferecemos oportunidades para talentos que estão ingressando no mercado de trabalho e somos apaixonados por impulsionar a nossa gente.


DESCRIÇÃO DO PROGRAMA


O Programa Regional Select engloba todas as áreas do Mundo Vendas , incluindo Comercial, Logística 2º e 3º Tier e Financeiro. O programa tem duração aproximada de 1 a 2 meses e visa à formação dos futuros líderes. Durante o treinamento, você fica imerso nas diferentes áreas do negócio e conhece algumas de nossas operações.


Além de aprender na prática, você permanece próximo a líderes que oferecem apoio para o seu desenvolvimento de carreira e para assumir novos desafios.


Esse programa possui um plano de treinamento amplo, com uma visão holística da companhia. Ao final do treinamento, o candidato, juntamente com o nosso time, define sua área de alocação. As áreas da Geo SP – Mundo Vendas incluem: vendas, nível de serviço, gente e gestão, financeiro e logística. Além disso, contamos com times especializados em produtos não alcoólicos, preços, processos e cervejas premium.

A alocação ocorre após o período de treinamento, podendo ser em Centros de Distribuição ou no Escritório Regional.


O QUE É O MUNDO VENDAS NA AMBEV?


Na prática, o Mundo Vendas é a área responsável por fazer nossos produtos chegarem a mais de um milhão de pontos de venda no Brasil, além de cuidar do desenvolvimento das nossas pessoas no ambiente comercial. É a área que garante que a cerveja do boteco do seu Zé, o Guaraná Antarctica do restaurante da esquina ou as bebidas de grandes eventos como Lollapalooza, Carnaval e Copa do Mundo estejam sempre disponíveis e geladas.

Durante o treinamento, os participantes passam por um mergulho em vendas, para que Talentos e Selects compreendam o mercado, a segmentação comercial e como atendemos, com qualidade, milhões de consumidores.


REQUISITOS

Capacidade de liderar equipes;

Facilidade de comunicação;

Bom relacionamento interpessoal;

Capacidade analítica;

Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;

Disposição para trabalhos externos.


  • Formação:

Ensino superior completo.

Desejável experiência em vendas e gestão de equipe.


  • Exigência:
  • CNH B definitiva, com limite de 8 pontos e sem multas gravíssimas.


BENEFÍCIOS


Hoje na AMBEV nós trabalhamos com os melhores benefícios para você e também para os seus dependentes legais! Aqui na companhia nós conseguimos te proporcionar:


  • Mais cuidado com a sua saúde através de Plano Médico, Odontológico, Telemedicina, Seguro de Vida e Wellhub.
  • Saúde mental com a Telemedicina Dasa.
  • Consumir nossos produtos com um super desconto (é isso mesmo, nós temos venda de produtos para funcionários no precinho! )
  • Reuniões de final de ano com a família ainda mais prazerosas, pois oferecemos Cesta de Natal e ainda brinquedo para quem tem filhos
  • Proteção financeira com a nossa previdência privada
  • A possibilidade de você fazer um bom mercado ou comer no restaurante que você gosta com Vale Alimentação ou Refeição , pois você poderá optar por um destes benefícios
  • O vale transporte é opcional e você pode conferir no modelo da vaga
  • Ter a oportunidade de receber um abono assiduidade, que nada mais é do que o 14º salário para nossos colaboradores, um salário extra no ano!
  • Auxílio Creche ou Auxílio babá
  • Participação dos Lucros da companhia


VENHA FAZER PARTE DO TIME

title: Solution Architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Solution Architect


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Participate in process and business requirements sessions and document to-be business processes leveraging industry best practices.
  • Identify and collect data, such as historical sales, shipment, inventory, logistics, and other operations / supply chain data from sources like databases, excel sheets, emails and others.
  • Ability to convert business logic to technical platform design, including knowledge of platform infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Architects and Directors to develop clear functional and technical design and document data requirements and build complex datasets.
  • Configure a technical specification document and tool configuration in the o9 platform as per the design to solve deep operations / supply chain problems and institute rigorous performance monitoring systems.
  • Use mathematical models, predictive methods, statistical techniques, optimization algorithms and simulations to analyze, manipulate and interpret large enterprise data and provide business insights and data visualization to the client management.
  • Be proficient in statistical and optimization tools and programming languages to conduct data integration through extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) and create models to generate time series forecasts and operational plans
  • Work with Internal Research and Development Teams to resolve solution gaps and deploy fixes in the customer environment
  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test-cases and document issues and track progress at resolving issues.
  • Ability to design a testing protocol and implement with support from Junior Analysts, with the end goal of automating testing.
  • Work with Cross-Functional Teams, and IT and business stakeholders, to ensure successful planning and execution of projects.
  • Plan, develop and deliver Super User and End User training, for a global user base.
  • Mentor Junior Analysts to familiarize them with technical and business aspects of a project.


What you’ll have


  • Experience: Implementing supply chain planning solutions or working in the supply chain/ logistics organization.
  • Experience presenting on complex topics in a clear, concise, and easily understood manner
  • Prior experience in planning systems, and exposure to ERP tools
  • Firsthand experience leading a team through the full lifecycle of a supply chain planning solution implementation including business requirement gathering, solution design & development, UAT/SIT, go-live/cutover, and value realization
  • Experience using agile methodology to deliver large scale enterprise implementations
  • Education: Master’s Degree +4 or Bachelor Degree with 6 year experience required. Degrees in the following fields: in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields (including Supply Chain Engineering) with a concentration in operations or analytics.

Skills:

  • Supply planning experience and have worked or implemented one or multiple supply planning products is required
  • Knowledge of spreadsheets and software (Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets), document processing (Microsoft Word, Google Docs), presentation (Microsoft PowerPoint) is required
  • Knowledge and training in databases (SQL Server, MySQL) and skills one or more languages like SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar is required
  • Strong analytical techniques, data mining knowledge and proficiency in handling and processing large amounts of data is preferred
  • Ability to identify key insights and critical thinking to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is preferred Coursework and strong background in mathematics and statistics is required
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation and demonstration / training skills are required
  • Ability to communicate mathematical, technical or software usage concepts to audiences with limited prior mathematics, technical or software background is preferred
  • Ability to work in teams, distributed across locations and time zones and at executive and junior levels in a corporate hierarchy is required


What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works

  1. Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  2. Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  3. Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  4. Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  5. Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  6. Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  7. HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More About Us


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Arquiteto em Governança de Dados - Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 57543


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Principais responsabilidades


  • Definir, implementar e evoluir processos, políticas, papéis e responsabilidades de Governança de Dados, alinhados ao DMBOK (DAMA)
  • Atuar nas frentes de Qualidade de Dados, Segurança e Acesso, Metadados e MDM (Master Data Management)
  • Desenhar e manter Arquiteturas de Dados e de Ambiente Analítico, incluindo estratégias de ingestão e integração de dados.
  • Definir padrões de nomenclatura, catalogação, linhagem e metadados em plataformas de dados.
  • Criar e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores de qualidade, segurança e maturidade de dados.
  • Liderar e apoiar PoCs de ferramentas de Governança, Qualidade de Dados, Metadados e MDM.
  • Atuar no levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio e stakeholders
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BI Self-Service e modernização de ambientes analíticos.
  • Orientar e mentorar equipes técnicas, disseminando boas práticas de arquitetura, integração e governança de dados.
  • Contribuir para a definição de arquiteturas de referência, garantindo aderência dos projetos aos padrões definidos.


Requisitos técnicos


  • Sólida experiência em Governança de Dados, Arquitetura de Dados e Business Intelligence
  • Forte conhecimento em modelagem de dados
  • Experiência com Qualidade de Dados, Metadados, MDM e Segurança da Informação aplicada a dados
  • Atuação em ambientes analíticos corporativos de médio e grande porte
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem, especialmente Fabric, Purview Conhecimento em estratégias de integração e ingestão de dados
  • Experiência com metodologias Ágeis e Cascata
  • Noções de SQL e Python
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio


Modelo de atuação


  • Vaga híbrida em São Paulo, 3x presenciais na semana.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Lead Training Consultant – SAP IBP & ePPDS
description:
About Company::


Bristlecone is a supply chain and business analytics advisor, serving customers across a wide range of industries. Rated by Gartner as among the top ten system integrators in the supply chain space, we are uniquely positioned to solve contemporary business problems, with supply chain and analytics focus as our advantage. We have been a trusted partner and advisor to many leading, globally recognized companies such as Applied Materials, Exxon Mobil, Flextronics, LSI Logic, Mahindra, Motorola, Nestle, Palm, Qatar Petroleum, Ranbaxy, Unilever and Whirlpool and many others.


Role Overview:


Language Required- Spanish Speaking

Should be open to travel to Mexico on needed basis


Role Objective

The Lead Training Consultant will be responsible for the end-to-end educational lifecycle of our digital supply chain transformation. This role requires a unique individual who can not only configure SAP IBP and ePPDS modules but also translate complex technical processes into comprehensive training programs for diverse business audiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Training Strategy: Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to identify skill gaps and design a global curriculum covering SAP IBP (Demand, S&OP, Response & Supply) and ePPDS.
  • Content Development: Create high-quality, multi-format training materials including Instructor-Led Training (ILT) decks, Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), video tutorials, and interactive eLearning modules.
  • Hands-on Facilitation: Deliver engaging training sessions to Super Users and End Users, utilizing real-world business scenarios in a dedicated training environment.
  • Environment Management: Manage and maintain the SAP training landscape (Sandbox), ensuring master data is refreshed and aligned for practical hands-on labs.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provide critical Hypercare support and refresher training post-deployment to ensure high system adoption and user proficiency.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical Mastery: Deep functional knowledge of SAP IBP (specifically Order-Based Planning ) and ePPDS (embedded Production Planning & Detailed Scheduling) in S/4HANA.
  • Training Expertise: Proven experience in end-to-end training delivery for large-scale SAP implementations, from curriculum design to final assessment.
  • Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, capacity planning, and detailed production scheduling.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical users.
  • Certification: SAP IBP or SCM Professional certification is highly preferred.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful execution of the global training calendar within project timelines.
  • High user adoption rates and positive training effectiveness scores.
  • Minimal post-go-live support tickets related to "lack of knowledge" or process errors

title: Explorers Manager (After-school Program)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description

The Explorers Manager leads Avenues’ after-school, winter, summer, and academic travel programs, ensuring high-quality learning experiences beyond the classroom that advance the school’s mission. This role combines strategic vision, team leadership, operational excellence, and financial stewardship to deliver programs that inspire students to explore passions, take risks, and grow as global citizens.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of all Explorers programs, including after-school, winter, summer, and academic national and international trips.
  • Develop a clear vision for Explorers programming aligned with Avenues’ educational philosophy and strategic priorities.
  • Recruit, onboard, and manage Explorers staff and more than 30 third-party providers.
  • Partner with academic leadership to design trips aligned with classroom learning.
  • Oversee program logistics, operations, and risk management to ensure smooth and safe execution.
  • Manage the Explorers budget in collaboration with the Finance team.
  • Monitor program quality, enrollment, and satisfaction, using data and feedback to drive improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the school and the Nord Anglia network.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; degree in Education or a related field is a plus.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English.
  • Experience leading or developing educational, enrichment, or experiential programs (extended-day, arts, sports, or experiential learning preferred).
  • Demonstrated ability to build programs and processes in dynamic or ambiguous environments.
  • Strong people management skills, including hiring, onboarding, and managing internal teams and external partners.
  • Experience managing budgets and using data to inform strategic and operational decisions.
  • Proven experience planning and leading national and/or international student trips.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong alignment with Avenues’ mission, values, and commitment to global citizenship.


Additional Information


Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.


Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Analista de Cultura e Engajamento Pleno (Pesquisa de Clima)
description:
Sobre a empresa


Como empresa líder em tecnologia somos um universo de pessoas inconformadas, movidas por inovação, autonomia, aprendizado e performance.


Juntos e juntas, criamos oportunidades, transformamos futuros e compartilhamos conhecimento. Aqui o seu desenvolvimento profissional acontece em um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e energizante. De gente pra gente!


Buscamos o crescimento sustentável. E usamos dados e IA para impulsionar resultados mais inteligentes e eficientes para os nossos clientes.


Vem com a gente inovar e construir o futuro da tecnologia.


#VemPraTOTVS #SomosTOTVS

title: Auxiliar de laboratório - Vaga Terceirizada

Apoio às Rotinas Regulatórias e Documentais

  • Preparar, atualizar e arquivar documentos e registros do laboratório (mapa para Exército, PF, PC, formulários, planilhas, etc.).
  • Manter rastreabilidade de dados e registros associados ao uso de reagentes, amostras e equipamentos.
  • Auxiliar na organização de pastas, sistemas internos e documentação de conformidade.


Suporte Geral às Atividades de P&D

  • Auxiliar na preparação de soluções simples, kits de protótipo, ensaios básicos ou atividades preparatórias, conforme orientação.
  • Apoiar na organização de bancadas, limpeza de utensílios, reposição de materiais e ordem geral do laboratório.
  • Apoiar pesquisadores em demandas operacionais, logísticas ou administrativas associadas ao dia a dia de P&D.
  • Contribuir para a manutenção de um ambiente seguro, organizado e eficiente.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Técnico ou Tecnólogo em Química, Química industrial, ou similares.
  • Experiência com Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL)
  • Conhecimento básico em manuseio de reagentes, vidrarias e equipamentos simples de laboratório (pHmetro, balança etc.).
  • Noções de segurança química e uso correto de EPIs.
  • Capacidade de seguir procedimentos operacionais padrão e instruções de trabalho.
  • Noções de segregação e descarte adequado de resíduos laboratoriais.


Desejável:

  • Técnico ou Tecnólogo em Química, Química industrial, ou similares.
  • Inglês
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de registro laboratorial e organização documental.
  • Experiência prévia com controle de estoque técnico e contato com fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento básico sobre requisitos regulatórios (Exército, Polícia Federal, Polícia Civil) aplicáveis ao uso e controle de reagentes.
  • Entendimento geral de normas de EHS (segurança, resíduos, emergências).
  • Capacidade de leitura de Fichas de Segurança (FISPQ/SDS).


Local da Vaga: Vila Mariana (São Paulo)

Modalidade de trabalho : Presencial

Horário : 09h00 às 18h00.


Sobre a Stepan:

Fundada em 1932, a Stepan Company é uma importante fabricante de produtos químicos básicos e intermediários, incluindo surfactantes, polímeros, bem como ingredientes especiais que entram em produtos de consumo, domésticos e institucionais, como detergentes para roupas, xampus e limpadores de superfícies. A Stepan Company possui atualmente 20 fábricas globais e mais de 2.000 funcionários. Temos um forte histórico de crescimento. title: Lider de Consultoria e Processos
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Líder de Consultoria e Processos



Resumo do Propósito da Função:

Como um contribuinte fundamental para a excelência operacional, o Consultor de Processos & Melhoria Contínua (CI) conduz iniciativas impactantes de melhoria de processos em toda a organização. Atuando como um assessor de confiança, este cargo é responsável por padronizar, implementar e otimizar processos críticos para aumentar a eficiência e o desempenho. Utilizando sua expertise em melhoria contínua, o consultor garante que as soluções estejam alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais e entreguem resultados mensuráveis e sustentáveis, promovendo uma cultura de inovação e progresso contínuo.

O Consultor Interno de Processos & CI trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Head de Consultoria de Processos, assegurando alinhamento com a estratégia global e contribuindo para os objetivos mais amplos estabelecidos no plano de 5 anos (5YP) e em outras iniciativas estratégicas de negócios.



Responsabilidades:

• Desenho Excelência Operacional e Otimização de Processos: apoiar e conduzir iniciativas de melhoria de processos destinadas a elevar a excelência operacional, simplificando processos, estimulando a inovação, melhorando a eficiência e desenvolvendo novas formas de trabalho. Realizar análises detalhadas para identificar ineficiências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos existentes, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Assegurar que as mudanças sejam sustentáveis, implementadas de forma eficaz e que seu impacto no desempenho seja mensurável.

• Desenho e Otimização de Processos End-to-End (E2E): atuar como consultor no design e implementação de processos operacionais eficientes, garantindo a criação de soluções robustas e escaláveis que ampliem o desempenho operacional em toda a organização. Ter um papel fundamental na tomada de decisões operacionais, garantindo que os processos sejam concebidos para serem replicáveis e adaptáveis em diferentes regiões e contextos. Oferecer suporte e assistência contínua no desenvolvimento de soluções operacionais personalizadas, alinhadas ao pipeline de desenvolvimento de Operações & TI, agilizando processos, sistemas e ferramentas para criar um ambiente de trabalho mais eficiente e eficaz.

• Colaboração Multifuncional: atuar como elo entre as operações locais para facilitar o trabalho colaborativo entre equipes, assegurando alinhamento e compartilhamento de conhecimento para promover uma cultura de processos padronizados, disseminação de boas práticas e melhoria contínua.

• Medição de Desempenho: desenvolver indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) para avaliar processos, desempenho de serviços e o impacto das iniciativas de melhoria, fornecendo insights aos stakeholders e apoiando ferramentas e sistemas que garantam dados provenientes de fontes válidas e integradas.

• Programa de Melhoria Contínua: colaborar como parte da equipe global de Melhoria Contínua para executar, monitorar e aprimorar o programa. Engajar-se ativamente e apoiar a rede de colaboradores treinados para impulsionar projetos contínuos de melhoria de processos, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais e entregando ganhos de desempenho mensuráveis.

• Colaboração Geográfica: apoiar equipes operacionais desde a Malásia até a Costa Rica, com base em prioridades definidas e em coordenação com o gestor direto, garantindo uma colaboração fluida e eficiente entre equipes/regiões.

• Executar tarefas atribuídas pelo Head de Consultoria de Processos com base nas prioridades do ELT e iniciativas estratégicas.



Competências:

• Adaptar o estilo de comunicação para transmitir mensagens de forma eficaz a diferentes públicos dentro das equipes e a stakeholders, garantindo clareza e promovendo compreensão nas interações do dia a dia.

• Facilitar reuniões e discussões de equipe, assegurando que ações e prazos claros sejam definidos, mantendo a equipe alinhada e focada na entrega dos objetivos do projeto.

• Construção de relações de trabalho positivas e promover a colaboração dentro das equipes de Operações (países e domínios) e com outros stakeholders, garantindo trabalho em equipe eficaz e partilha de ideias para apoiar o sucesso dos projetos.

• Identificar proativamente áreas de melhoria e assumir a responsabilidade de impulsionar iniciativas de melhoria contínua dentro das diferentes equipas, garantindo progresso rumo aos objetivos operacionais.

• Influenciar de forma eficaz colegas e membros da equipe para obter apoio às iniciativas de melhoria de processos, utilizando persuasão e colaboração para garantir alinhamento e implementação bem-sucedida das mudanças.




CONHECIMENTOS & EXPERIÊNCIA:

Essencial:

• Proficiência na metodologia Lean Six Sigma (certificação Green Belt ou superior).

• Experiência comprovada em mapeamento de processos e metodologias de melhoria de processos.

• Experiência na implementação de ferramentas e técnicas de melhoria contínua, como Kaizen e DMAIC (Definir, Medir, Analisar, Melhorar, Controlar).

• Capacidade de liderar projetos de melhoria de processos de ponta a ponta de forma eficaz.

• Proficiência no uso e desenvolvimento em ferramentas online da Microsoft, como SharePoint, Power Automate e Power BI.

• Proficiência em inglês falado e escrito.




Desejável:

• Experiência em liderar e orientar iniciativas de Melhoria Contínua (CI).

• Familiaridade com princípios e práticas de gestão de projetos, incluindo fundamentos de Agile/Scrum.

• Proficiência em espanhol, falado e escrito, é uma vantagem.



O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho hibrido
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

description:

i4pro + você = i4evc

· Arquitetar e desenvolver serviços e APIs em C# (.NET / .NET Core) seguindo boas práticas (REST, SOLID, Clean Architecture, Clean Code).

· Desenvolver e manter interfaces React escaláveis e acessíveis (Hooks, Context, estado global; preferencialmente com TypeScript).

· Modelar dados e implementar consultas eficientes em bancos SQL (ex.: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL) e NoSQL (ex.: MongoDB, DynamoDB).

· Containerizar aplicações e configurar ambientes com Docker (multi-stage builds, compose), apoiando pipelines de CI/CD.

· Garantir qualidade com testes unitários, de integração e end-to-end, revisão de código e boas práticas de engenharia.

· Zelar por segurança (authN/authZ, OWASP Top 10), observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing) e performance.

· Mentorar o time, disseminar boas práticas e participar ativamente de code reviews e design reviews.

· Colaborar com Produto, QA e UX para descoberta e entrega contínua (Lean, Agile, Kanban/Scrum).

· Escrever documentação técnica clara e sustentável (arquitetura, decisões técnicas, guias de setup).



Você também precisa ter:

· Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend com C# (.NET) e frontend com React.

· Domínio de APIs REST, versionamento de APIs e integração com serviços externos.

· Experiência prática com .NET Core, injeção de dependência, middlewares e pipelines HTTP.

· Prática avançada com Docker em projetos reais (build, distribuição e execução em diferentes ambientes).

· Experiência comprovada com SQL (modelagem relacional, queries otimizadas) e NoSQL.

· Conhecimento em Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e integração contínua (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps).

· Vivência em arquiteturas escaláveis, caching, mensageria (ex.: RabbitMQ, Kafka) e observabilidade.

· Boa comunicação, autonomia e forte postura de ownership.

· Graduação em área de tecnologia.


Se você tiver, será um diferencial:

· Práticas de “vibe coding”, utilizando agentes, prompts e IDEs modernas (Cursor, VS Code + agentes).

· Experiência com Entity Framework Core, Dapper ou ORMs similares.

· Conhecimento em TypeScript no frontend.

· Frameworks do ecossistema React (Next.js, React Query, Redux Toolkit).

· Experiência em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e Kubernetes.

· Segurança de APIs (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), feature flags, blue/green ou canary releases.

· Participação ativa em comunidades, artigos técnicos ou contribuições open source.



Nosso modelo de trabalho:

Priorizamos o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores, com posições em formato remoto, presencial ou presencial com política de home office, que é definido conforme as necessidades da vaga e as atribuições do cargo.


No caso dessa posição, a atuação é de forma remota.



Nosso escritório fica na Avenida Angélica, 2133 – próximo do metrô Paulista.




A i4pro apoia a diversidade e inclusão de PCD em todas as suas vagas.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:

  • Who gets funded
  • How and when we collect
  • Where we allocate risk capital

You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency.

Your focus: deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.


Specifically, you will:

  • Model borrower risk : Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud : Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions : Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we know who to contact, how , and when .
  • Design experiments : Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work : Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage : Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of SQL , Python , and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
  • Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
  • Solid understanding of business economics: marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.

Nice to have:

  • Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
  • Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).

Languages:

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.
